items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 04.02.2026 (Wednesday). The period is '10 Kalendertage nach dem Rechnungsdatum'. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (04.02.2026) is not counted; counting begins 05.02.2026. Ten calendar days later lands on 14.02.2026 (Saturday). This is a payment owed to a company, so under § 270 Abs. 4 / §§ 269 BGB the payer's own Land (NRW) determines regional holidays; 14.02.2026 is not a holiday in NRW but is a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB the due date of a payment falling on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday moves to the next working day: Monday, 16.02.2026 (no intervening holiday).
